Short Transfer now sends roughly three seconds of leader before both the header and data blocks, while still sending each block only once. The previous one-second data leader could end before the Sharp monitor began looking for the tape marker. Conventional timing is unchanged.

The new timing passes software encoder tests. Physical MZ-1500 loading with this build has not yet been verified.

Download **MZT-Player-1.5.1-macOS-arm64.zip** for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. **SHA256SUMS.txt** contains the archive checksum. The build is ad hoc signed and not Apple-notarised.
